concepts.definition: The type of audit or review modification recorded against the charity's lodged financial report for the reporting period, such as a qualified opinion or a disclaimer of opinion. Only populated where a modification is flagged.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept describes report modification types; it is a charity-owned regulatory reporting attribute distinct from registration status, financial statement type and the y/n modification flag. Values are limited to those evidenced in the column examples.

reuse.dyn.charity.ais_due_date: Reused: ACNC-published AIS lodgement deadline, charity-owned, date type, no qualifiers needed; distinct from licence and business registration dates.
reuse.dyn.charity.ais_received_date: Reused: AIS receipt date is a distinct regulatory lodgement event from financial report receipt and business registration.
reuse.dyn.charity.size_band: Reused: ACNC Small/Medium/Large reporting classification owned by charity; not ext.financial.revenue_band (business-owned revenue band).
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_period_star: Reused: start of the charity's own reporting period; not ext.entity.financial_year_end (dd-Mon cycle marker).
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end: Reused: end of the charity's own reporting period; not ext.entity.financial_year_end.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_received_da: Reused: financial report receipt date, distinct from AIS receipt date.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_statement_type: Reused: accounting framework of the lodged statement; not legal form or entity type.
reuse.dyn.charity.report_modified: Reused: y/n modification flag, a different ACNC attribute from registration status and basic religious charity.
reuse.dyn.charity.report_consolidated: Reused: report consolidation scope flag; must not be read as a group-structure or control claim.
reuse.dyn.charity.coop_financial_report_submit: Reused: submission flag to a cooperative regulator; not evidence of cooperative legal form.
reuse.dyn.charity.accounting_basis: Reused: Cash/Accrual reporting basis; distinct from financial statement type.

fields.rationale: Column is the ACNC-published AIS lodgement deadline for the reporting year; matches dyn.charity.ais_due_date owned by the charity role. dd/mm/yyyy format per examples.
Column is the date the ACNC received the AIS; matches dyn.charity.ais_received_date. Distinct from financial report receipt date.
ACNC charity size classification (Small/Medium/Large) is a charity-owned reporting band, not a business revenue band; matches dyn.charity.size_band.
Start of the charity's own financial reporting period; matches dyn.charity.financial_report_period_start. Not a business financial year end marker.
End of the charity's own financial reporting period; matches dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end.
Date the ACNC received the charity's financial report; matches dyn.charity.financial_report_received_date, a distinct lodgement event from AIS receipt.

mapping.general purpose financial statements sim: General purpose financial statements - simplified disclosure
mapping.general purpose financial statements - s: General purpose financial statements - simplified disclosure

fields.rationale: Accounting framework of the lodged statement; matches dyn.charity.financial_statement_type. Examples show both a whitespace-only and a hyphenated simplified-disclosure variant, so collapse_whitespace plus both keys normalise them to the canonical label.
y/n flag for whether the charity's report carries a modification; matches dyn.charity.report_modified.
Type of modification recorded against the report; matches dyn.charity.report_modification_type. Only populated where a modification is flagged, which the source already reflects.
